gui.justifylasers.client.portal_view.too: Adjust the gun FOV, size, position and rotation.
gui.justifylasers.client.portal_model.to: Default: voxel model. Realistic: smooth model with glass, emissive materials and animated claws. Applies immediately to every Portal Gun.
tooltip.justify_portal_gun.controls: Attack / Use: fire · G: grab / release · Holding: Attack throws, Use places · Middle mouse: zoom · Wheel in zoom: magnification · Sneak + fire: clear
tooltip.justify_portal_gun.dual: Attack: first color · Use: second color · This gun has its own portal pair.
tooltip.justify_portal_gun.single: Both fire buttons shoot this gun's color. Your blue and orange single guns share a separate pair.
message.justifylasers.portal_invalid: A portal needs a clear, flat 1 x 2 surface.
tooltip.justifylasers.portal_gun: Attack: blue / throw · Use: orange / place · G: grab / release · Middle mouse: zoom · Wheel while zoomed: magnification · Sneak + fire: clear
gui.justifylasers.client.portal_views.to: Live world views through linked portals. Traversal remains active when disabled.
gui.justifylasers.client.portal_distance: Maximum distance in blocks for rendering the world through a portal.
gui.justifylasers.client.portal_limit.to: Maximum camera captures per frame, including nested portals. Higher values use more GPU memory.
Render portal views with the current shader pack. Experimental; some packs do not support a second camera.
gui.justifylasers.client.portal_emission: Submit colored emissive portal rims and projectiles to the shader lighting pass. Requires a shader pack with emissive material lighting.
gui.justifylasers.client.portal_recursio: 1–8 linked camera levels. The shared view budget can limit the actual depth. Each level adds another world render.
gui.justifylasers.client.portal_volume.t: Local volume for portal ambience, crossings, gun shots and object pickup. Minecraft's sound sliders still apply.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.title: Portal gun view
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.preset: Original view. Restores the original FOV, position and size.
Angled view with a visible glass chamber.
Restore your last custom settings for this model.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.fov.to: 30–110°. Lower values enlarge the gun. Only the gun and hands change; the world FOV stays the same.
0.35–2.00. Uniform size of the gun and hands, independent of FOV. Enter an exact value on the right.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.x.tool: −0.75 to 0.75 blocks. Positive moves away from the screen center, mirrored for the left hand.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.y.tool: −0.75 to 0.75 blocks. Positive moves up; negative moves down.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.z.tool: −0.50 to 0.50 blocks. Positive moves closer to the camera; negative moves farther away.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.yaw.to: Turn sideways: −60° to 60°. Mirrored for the other hand.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.roll.t: Roll around the barrel: −60° to 60°. Mirrored for the other hand.
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.live: Changes are visible in your hands
gui.justifylasers.client.gun_view.hold_g: Hold a gun in first person to preview
tooltip.justify_portal_gun.companion_car: Right-click: carry / release. G with a portal gun: grab.
tooltip.justify_portal_gun.companion_col: Attack: kick. Sneak + use: rotate. Sneak + attack: collect.
